It premiered on Disney+ on March 24, 2026, marking exactly two decades since the original series debut in 2006.[2] The special was filmed in front of a live studio audience and features an exclusive, in-depth interview with Miley Cyrus, who portrayed the title character in the original series, hosted by podcast host Alex Cooper. The program includes the recreation of iconic sets such as the Stewart family living room and Hannah Montana’s closet, and retrospective discussion on the show’s cultural impact. Background[] In 2024, Miley Cyrus was inducted as a Disney Legend by The Walt Disney Company.[3] During her acceptance speech, she reflected on the cultural impact of Hannah Montana and credited the series as a formative part of both her career and personal life, stating that she remained proud to have portrayed the titular character. While promoting her visual album Something Beautiful in 2025, Cyrus referenced the approaching 20th anniversary of Hannah Montana on multiple occasions.[4] In interviews, she expressed interest in commemorating the milestone and hinted at plans to create something special for longtime fans of the series. On August 6, 2025, a fan-operated social media account dedicated to Cyrus released a teaser video purporting to preview an anniversary project.[5] The clip amassed more than 32 million views and was subsequently reported on by several international media outlets as an official announcement. The account later issued a public statement clarifying that the video was a fan-made concept created using artificial intelligence and was not affiliated with Cyrus or Disney. The incident prompted widespread online speculation regarding potential anniversary plans. On February 18, 2026, it was officially announced that a Hannah Montana 20th anniversary special would premiere on Disney+. The special was filmed in front of a live studio audience on February 27, 2026.[6] On March 13, D23 announced a free premiere event that took place on March 23, 2026, in Los Angeles.[7] Songs[] The Best of Both Worlds This Is the Life The Climb Younger You Videos[] Gallery[] References[] ↑ DisneyPlus: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special ↑ Disney+ Press Center: Miley Cyrus Returns Home For The “Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special,” Streaming March 24 On Disney+ ↑ @Disney on YouTube: Miley Cyrus | 2024 Disney Legends Ceremony ↑ @siriusxm on YouTube: Miley Cyrus Reacts to 20 Years of Hannah Montana ↑ @MileyNation13 on X (August 6, 2025) ↑ @MileyCyrusBz on X (February 24, 2025) ↑ Fantasy Land News: D23 Just Announced a Free Hannah Montana Premiere Event and the Ticket Queue Is Already Open Community content is available under CC-BY-SA unless otherwise noted.
